source_work: create the implementation Task Contract for PLAN-PILOT-TODO-GROWTH-001 version 2
problem: Plan version 2 defines task_contract_pending only when no Task Contract exists and implementation_in_progress only when a Task is active. It does not define the state of a created and verified Task Contract before its containing commit and before WI-001 begins.
impact: creating the Task Contract would require an unapproved derived state
using implementation_in_progress would falsely report that WI-001 has begun
using task_contract_pending would conflict with the existence of the Task Contract
Challenge version 2 obligation_coverage and oracle_quality pass results are incomplete for this boundary

evidence.result: Only ACC-007 in Plan version 2 defines the relevant states; no intermediate state or resolver rule exists.

stop_decision.reason: The gap affects Acceptance truth and current-state authority; the Task Contract must not choose a state that the approved Plan does not define.

options.label: add explicit pre-implementation states
options.description: Create Plan version 3 with task_contract_commit_pending for an uncommitted contract and implementation_ready for a committed verified contract; enter implementation_in_progress only when WI-001 begins.
options.tradeoff: Requires Plan version 3, Challenge version 3, and a new Human Plan decision before Task Contract creation.

options.label: treat contract creation as implementation start
options.description: Create the contract as active and immediately derive implementation_in_progress.
options.tradeoff: Conflicts with the approved separate work-unit and commit-before-implementation boundary.

options.label: reuse task_contract_pending
options.description: Keep task_contract_pending while a non-active Task Contract already exists.
options.tradeoff: Makes the state name and ACC-007 condition inaccurate and weakens deterministic interpretation.

not_authorized: modify Plan version 2 or Challenge version 2 in place
create the implementation Task Contract before the state gap is resolved
begin WI-001, snapshot TODO, or compact TODO
promote this candidate as a second Issue subject
next_action: Obtain Human authorization to create Plan version 3, perform Challenge version 3, and request a new Plan decision.
